element.name: Value

spriteSheetComponent.name: Icon
spriteSheetComponent.event:
local storeItemType = element:parent()("CurrencyType"):GetString() local currencyType = game.StoreContext_StoreTypeToCurrency(storeItemType) local currencyProps = require("Currencies"):getProps(currencyType) currencyProps:applyToSpriteSheet(component) currencyProps:normalizeSizeW(component, 0.35*game.hudScale())
component("layer"):SetString("$layer")
if(element:parent().isAnimated) then component("visible"):SetInt(0) end

aeComponent.name: AnimatedIcon
aeComponent.event:
component("animationName"):SetString("xml_bin/Relic_confetti01.bin") component("animation"):SetString("wild card rotation") component:setScale(Vector2(0.15*game.hudScale(), 0.15*game.hudScale())) component("layer"):SetString("$layer")
if(element:parent().isAnimated == false) then component("visible"):SetInt(0) end

textComponent.name: Text
textComponent.event:
component("font"):Set(game.getTitleFont()) component("size"):SetFloat(0.4*game.menuScaleX()) component("alignment"):SetInt(MenuTextComponent_TEXT_LEFT_ALIGNED) component("text"):SetString("?")
local currencyType = element:parent()("CurrencyType"):GetString(); if(currencyType ~= "") then game.StoreContext_setCurrencyTypeColour(currencyType, component) end
component("layer"):SetString("$layer") component("autoScaleFactor"):SetFloat(0.01) component("autoScale"):SetInt(1)
